summary: Fortinet FortiGate firewalls with the ATP subscription bundle, the base threat protection: firewall, IPS, gateway antivirus, VPN and a cloud sandbox.
value: Known attacks, exploits and malicious files are blocked between the internet and the network.
Offices and remote workers connect over an encrypted VPN.
Unknown files are checked in a cloud sandbox.
simple: Fortinet FortiGate next-generation firewalls — hardware models from desktop units for branches to data-center chassis (built on Fortinet’s own security processors) and virtual FortiGate-VM for private and public clouds; the product here is a FortiGuard subscription bundle that applies to any model. FortiOS itself provides a firewall with application and user control, SSL/TLS decryption, IPsec and SSL VPN for offices and remote workers, and SD-WAN; management via FortiManager or the cloud. The Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) bundle is the entry-level threat protection: An intrusion prevention system (IPS) with deep traffic inspection, antivirus and malware protection including mobile malware, blocking of connections to known botnets, protection against new threat outbreaks (Outbreak Prevention), a cloud sandbox for unknown files (detection only) and SaaS application control (CASB). Web and DNS filtering, DLP and security rating are not part of this bundle.
notIncluded: No website and DNS filtering: that comes with the UTP bundle.
No DLP or security rating: those are in Enterprise Protection.
classification: The product is the FortiGuard bundle, models are in the text only; IPS, antivirus and Botnet at the gateway are within NGFW.
Sandbox SaaS (detection only) is the sandbox class.
